Moon: Mine

April 25, 2026

I want to make the moon mine

I want the moon to be mine,
Due to which I might take away its shine,
But the moon is still the moon,
Whether it is a new, crescent, half, or full, the moon is still the moon.

I want the moon to be mine,
On its good days, I desire the moon,
I desire it the most, on its bad ones.
I want the moon to be mine,
Even if it loses its shine,
I’ll make it mine.

I wish for it to be mine,
When it is full,
More when it is halfway there and almost whole,
Even more when it is crescent,
The most when it is a new moon.

I want the moon to be mine
In all its phases, which people named,
To me, the moon is the same,
In every phase people named.

At last, the moon shall be mine,
May I be called selfish for making it mine,
But ‘tis what I desire, so it shall be mine.

Mine is what I want to call the moon,
More than call it the moon.

— Asahi Hoshizora
